authority: worker-plan.html section 8.1 (tables 18-19); local WP0 catalog inventory from published ae9dffe2da2bca33c01daee1eaacfcbedfc95aa0
expectationProvenance: search-fixtures.json was authored from plan-required operator queries and frozen catalog identities before production ranking implementation; expected answers do not import or call production evaluators

metadataApi.input: Actual model or preset descriptor; optional ids/catalogAttributeIds and keyed attribute definitions. Core must supply its own actual attribute IDs. No steps(), withVariant(), field histories or trace parser is invoked.

output.searchTags: Canonical deduplicated base aliases, taught title clauses and legacy keywords through adaptScenarioSearchTags exactly once
output.searchIdentifiers: Stable row ID and actual attribute IDs/names; separately indexed exact values
output.searchContext: Only base summary/category/status/real protocol/workspace/family/objective/prerequisites, primitive profile strings and attribute names/standards

metadataApi.validation: validateScenarioSearchMetadata(entries) requires exact registry/catalog identity coverage, nonblank/nonduplicate authored tags and valid curated variant targets; unknown rows and duplicate case IDs throw
metadataApi.legacyAdapter: adaptScenarioSearchTags(searchTags=[],keywords=[]) is the sole legacy keyword adapter; downstream consumers never flatten keywords again

ranking.tier0: Exact normalized identifier, title or curated tag phrase
ranking.tier1: All terms are whole tokens in the same destination title/tags/identifiers; input token order does not matter
ranking.tier2: At least one boundary prefix in strong fields, with every term otherwise matched; minimum prefix length is three characters
ranking.tier3: At least one whole-token or boundary-prefix incidental summary/profile/category/attribute-context match; all terms still must match the same destination
ranking.ties: Stable original options order; duplicate query terms/tags/context and oversized lists do not add score
ranking.normalization: NFKD accent folding, lowercase, whitespace collapse, punctuation/separator folding except significant plus. CODE_VERIFIER, EAP-TLS and full IDs remain exact indexed inputs. SPAKE2 does not prefix-match SPAKE2+, while spake finds both; compact RunAsPPL/run as ppl aliases are explicit.
ranking.acronyms: No arbitrary interior substring search; lsa cannot match tlsalert or TLS alert. Prefixes begin at token boundaries only.
ranking.cache: WeakMap per option; content signature includes ID/title/category/summary/searchText/tags/identifiers/context/variant descriptors. In-place nested metadata edits invalidate. Only lightweight descriptors are serialized; no evaluator work per keystroke.
ranking.emptyQuery: Original identity order, one row per identity; existing category browsing groups are retained
ranking.sameDestination: Base fields may combine with one case's fields; terms from separate cases can never satisfy one result

resultApi.identity: Original row id, once per scenario/preset identity
resultApi.uniqueCase: Shallow result row adds variantId and caseLabel
resultApi.multipleCases: Shallow result row adds matchingVariantIds, matchingCases:[{id,label}], and caseLabel='N matching cases'; no variantId/default is silently selected
resultApi.caseRelevance: If base matches, only stronger case-specific matches can redirect to a case; otherwise base browsing selection stays unchanged. All independently matching stronger cases remain choices, not merely the best-ranked case.
resultApi.pickerCallback: onSelect(id,result): first argument is backward-compatible; second is the exact currently displayed result captured before close()
resultApi.visibleOrder: Nonempty picker DOM is a flat ranked list with category labels; DOM order equals this.results and Arrow/Enter order exactly. Empty-query category headings are unchanged.
resultApi.privacy: Tags are data only, never hidden DOM prose or a tag cloud; visible labels are original titles, summaries, categories, profiles and concise actual case labels

integration: Import createScenarioSearchMetadata into app.js. Merge its return into every preset, Core and scenario option; remove old flattened searchText, including variant labels and model.protocol || oidc fallback. Provide actual attributes for presets and Core.
Library nonempty queries render the same filterScenarioOptions ordered option rows directly, including Core and presets; never convert matches to a Set and re-filter catalog order.

Callback receives (id,result). A unique result.variantId navigates to that exact validated case; result.matchingCases opens an explicit matching-case choice UI. No match silently becomes normal success/default.

Search typing/clearing/highlighting does not select or reset a running demonstration. Preserve selected title restoration, no-result Enter, focus/status/counts, IME composition and modified native navigation.

Add scenario-search-metadata.js before app.js in standalone flattening order. The new module has no imports, dependencies, filesystem access, runtime fetches or global platform API requirements. scenario-picker.js remains independently importable.

workgroup share: other SMB nonjoined denial/comparison cases teaching that share workflow
